public_rationale: On September 12, 2024, Salesforce announced Agentforce pricing starting at $2 per conversation, with general availability for Service and Sales planned for October 25 [e1]. On June 10, 2024, Apple announced AI integration into its consumer operating systems [e2]. These announcements show a planned paid SaaS offering and a consumer AI channel [e1, e2]. Neither establishes whether SaaS companies' need for something new to sell predominantly drove the technology industry's AI commitment by September 26, 2024 [e1, e2]. They also do not establish the proposed role of adding AI to existing products sold through bulk annual contracts signed by people who are not end users [e1, e2]. The evidence establishes neither the claimed causal dominance nor the predominance of another cause [e1, e2].
limitations: The announcements do not establish a prior shortage of meaningful new SaaS offerings or measure the causes of industry-wide AI commitment [e1, e2].
Announced products and prices do not establish realized sales or the contribution of bulk annual purchasing by non-users [e1, e2].

our_interpretation: Largely means that SaaS companies' need for new products is the predominant driver of the industry's AI commitment, without assigning an invented percentage.
The claim concerns the industry's commitment as it stood by September 26, 2024.
The descriptions of novelty, contracts and purchasers identify a proposed sales mechanism. They do not independently establish that mechanism's industry-wide dominance.
The subjective wording desperate and meaningful is not separately scored.
criteria.support_condition: Representative strategy and investment evidence establishes that SaaS vendors' need for new offerings predominantly caused the industry's AI commitment, with the proposed sales mechanism materially contributing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible comparative evidence establishes that other drivers predominated, or that the proposed SaaS sales mechanism was too limited to account for the industry's commitment.
